source_note: 满足这种函数极限性质的函数是几乎处处为0的
english_source_note: Such a Limit Property Forces a Function to Vanish a.e.
callout_id: 满足这种函数极限性质的函数是几乎处处为0的#2
english_title: Problem 2: A 2024 Mathematical Analysis Entrance Exam Problem
statement_en: Let $f:[a,b]\to \mathbb{R}$ satisfy that for every $x_0 \in [a,b]$, one has $\lim_{x\to x_0} f(x)=0$. Then $f$ is Riemann integrable on $[a,b]$ and its integral is $0$.
key_techniques: deducing almost everywhere vanishing from local limit behavior
comparison of upper and lower sums
prerequisites: definition of limit of a function
callout_body: 函数$f:[a,b]\to \mathbb{R}$满足对任意$\forall x_0 \in [a,b]$都有$\lim_{x\to x_0}f(x)=0$，那么函数在区间$[a,b]$上Riemann可积并且积分为0。
